findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "prompt:write_verified_circuit" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Write an OpenQASM 3 program for what it must do, read it with the engine, and check it against that intent before calling it done.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
